title: hancea subpeltata
intro: Hancea subpeltata, commonly known as the "Philippine Sandalwood," is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Hancea subpeltata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including santalol and alpha-santalol, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of this plant are also linked to its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation, making it a promising natural remedy for various conditions.
